use onc_rpc_xdr::{XdrDecode, XdrEncode};

pub const OCTAL_BOUND: i64 = 8;

pub type ratio_t = f32;

pub type measure_t = f64;

pub type wide_t = [u8; 16];

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct full_record_t {
    pub fixed: [u8; OCTAL_BOUND as usize],
    pub next: Option<Box<ratio_t>>,
}

impl XdrEncode for full_record_t {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::write_fixed_opaque(output, &self.fixed);
        self.next.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for full_record_t {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            fixed: <[u8; OCTAL_BOUND as usize] as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
            next: Option::<Box<ratio_t>>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum payload_t {
    Case1 {
        single: i32,
    },
    Case2 {
        text: String,
    },
    Case3 {
        text: String,
    },
    Default {
        discriminant: i32,
    },
}

impl XdrEncode for payload_t {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match self {
            Self::Case1 { single } => {
                (1).encode_xdr(output)?;
                single.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::Case2 { text } => {
                (2).encode_xdr(output)?;
                text.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::Case3 { text } => {
                (3).encode_xdr(output)?;
                text.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            Self::Default { discriminant } => {
                discriminant.encode_xdr(output)?;
                Ok(())
            }
        }
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for payload_t {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        let discriminant = <i32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?;
        match discriminant {
            1 => Ok(Self::Case1 { single: <i32 as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            2 => Ok(Self::Case2 { text: String::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            3 => Ok(Self::Case3 { text: String::decode_xdr(input)? }),
            discriminant => Ok(Self::Default { discriminant }),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(i32)]
pub enum inline_enum_t {
    VALUE_ONE = 1,
    VALUE_TWO = 2,
}

impl XdrEncode for inline_enum_t {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        (*self as i32).encode_xdr(output)
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for inline_enum_t {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        match i32::decode_xdr(input)? {
            1 => Ok(Self::VALUE_ONE),
            2 => Ok(Self::VALUE_TWO),
            other => Err(onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError::InvalidEnum(other)),
        }
    }
}
